caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an ornate oil lamp with a tall, faceted base and a square platform at the bottom. The lamp is predominantly colored in a deep purple hue, with lighter highlights to suggest reflections and surface texture. The base rises upward with a series of curved and angular indentations, leading to a bulbous midsection that narrows again before flaring outward near the top. At the top of the lamp, a metallic, silver-gray burner mechanism is visible, from which a thick, twisted fabric wick extends upward. The background of the drawing is a plain, beige color, with the lamp centered as the only object present. There is also a small, faint signature reading "JOHN EARL" in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Lamp
